answer: Deferred Liability Pinning: each new identity must post an onyx deposit that stays locked for ninety days, and any confirmed sybil cluster forfeits every deposit tied to the same controlling operator. The trellis of linked accounts is traced through shared funding sources, so a single detected clone reveals the whole set. At scale this turns each fake identity into a fixed sunk loss rather than a cheap retry, pushing the attacker's summit cost per useful account well above its value.
